caption: A classical oil painting of a robed woman wearing a laurel crown, seated outdoors, lifting the lid of an ornate box. Bold white meme text appears at the top of the image and again at the bottom.
ocr_text:
HEY
THERE'S SOMETHING

joke_summary: AI is being discovered inside Pandora's box, framing it as an ancient, ominous release of something dangerous or uncontrollable.
